claim_label: Sustainability Standards vs. AI Infrastructure Resource Requirements
description: The conflict centers on whether strict water-neutral consumption mandates are essential environmental safeguards or unnecessary constraints on AI technological development.

instances.assertion: Argues for a 'Net-Benefit' model where grid-stabilization and engineering efficiency offset resource use; treats water as a manageable utility.
Argues for a strict 'Zero-Net-Depletion' hard-stop; treats water as a non-negotiable physical floor for survival.
